name: toggle-lamp
description: A button toggles a redstone lamp between on and off using a modulo-2 state score. The chain is laid out west-to-east at y=64; the lamp is at 10 66 10 and the redstone block at 10 65 10.

blocks.command: execute if score #state lamp matches 1 run setblock 10 65 10 redstone_block
execute if score #state lamp matches 0 run setblock 10 65 10 air

tests: Press once: redstone block appears at 10 65 10 and the lamp at 10 66 10 lights.
Press again: redstone block becomes air and the lamp turns off.
Press 10 times: state alternates correctly, never goes negative or above 1.
Reload the world: #state keeps its value, so the next press still toggles.
Run /setblock 10 65 10 air manually: the next press resynchronizes the lamp.
notes: The two output blocks must be unconditional; the conditional chain would otherwise skip the second branch.
If the lamp gets out of sync, set #state manually or add a resync step that checks the block at 10 65 10.
